description:
The Epstein files are being unsealed — and with every release, the circle of silence grows harder to defend. Powerful names, hidden connections, and a network that reached further than most people want to believe. But as the story continues to unfold, one industry keeps coming up: music.
From Katy Perry to Justin Bieber to Kesha — disturbing imagery has been hiding in plain sight inside mainstream music videos. Cannibalism references. Ritual symbolism. Themes that would be unthinkable anywhere else — normalized and packaged for mass consumption. Why?
And then there's Baal. The ancient god of power, sacrifice, and false worship. Is it a coincidence that these symbols keep appearing? Or is something deeper at work?
The Epstein files are opening. The patterns are mounting. We're not making accusations — we're asking the questions no one else will. And we think you deserve to hear them.
